Ground textures of the city maps' streets (roads, cycle paths, pavements, brick and cobbled streets, gravel, kerbs):
Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), CC0 (public domain), 2k JPG colour and OpenGL normal maps:
asphalt_02, asphalt_04, clean_asphalt, herringbone_brick, brick_pavement_02, concrete_pavement, cobblestone_floor_08,
gravel_floor_02, concrete_floor_01. Put into Resources/MapAssets by MapSetup.AddGroundTextures.
cycle_red_diff_2k.jpg: clean_asphalt's colour map recoloured to the red asphalt of Dutch cycle paths (also CC0).
The lawn of grass areas is made from code: Tools/lawn_texture.py (Assets/Textures/Ground/Lawn).
